set.body: Implement a public, typed Ravel contract for allocation-free sequential access to whole canonical owned NDArray values and disciplined writes to whole canonical MutableNDArray outputs. Preserve ownership and layout validation; expose no raw platform buffer. Dispatch once before hot loops and retain primitive specialization on JVM and Scala.js. Migrate the ScalaFIM image composition workload only after exact parity tests. Acceptance: JVM and Scala.js core/law tests pass; no per-element allocation or callback dispatch; no full-volume copy; image workload remains exact and reaches within 10 percent of a same-run primitive oracle or records a visible ratified loss. Cross-store authority: reframe4s bd-01KYQ0RDDQH21EPB8VGAYXN3Q3.
set.title: Add certified whole-canonical traversal for image kernels
